requirements.title: A free-form physical line has at most 10000 characters
requirements.source: 6.3.2.1 p1, third sentence; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, PDF page 71, printed page 57, lines 12-13.
requirements.definition: A free-form source line is limited to 10000 characters, including leading blanks, trailing blanks, and any comment text. The limit is on each physical line, not on an entire continued statement. Empty lines and placement of statements anywhere within a line are permitted by the other sentences of this paragraph.
requirements.oracle: Eight out-of-band fixtures preserve ASCII input bytes and LF physical-line boundaries. Three paired shapes have a distinguished line of exactly 10000 or 10001 characters: a character-literal assignment whose final quote reaches the boundary, an ordinary assignment padded with trailing blanks, and a comment. At-limit controls compile, link, and run; over-limit cases require a source-located compile diagnostic on that line. Each invalid asset differs from its conforming repair by exactly one source character. A fourth 10000-character control starts its assignment after 9990 leading blanks. A separate 133-character control distinguishes the older configured 132-column limit without weakening the F2023 oracle. Every run control checks defined data; the long-literal control checks all 9990 x characters, the final Z, and blank padding.
requirements.oracle_limitation: These are byte-preserved ASCII witnesses: character and byte counts agree by construction. They do not establish character-count handling for multibyte encodings or the separate one-million-character statement limit in 6.3.2.6. No annotations, permissive line-length flags, or optional capability profiles are added. An older reference default that truncates at column 132 is configuration evidence, not a reason to reject the pinned F2023 premise or skip the case. 4.2 p2(5) requires reporting capability, not compulsory fatal rejection; nonfatal diagnostics unsupported by the existing runner remain a reporting-adapter limitation. A compiler crash or timeout never satisfies a negative case.
requirements.dependencies: 6.3.1 p1/p3 defines lines and source-form selection. 4.2 p2(1)/(5), PDF 46, supplies execution/reporting obligations. 6.3.2.3 supplies uncredited empty/comment-line context. 7.4.4.3, 9.4.1, and 10.2.1.3 supply the literal, in-bounds substrings, and character assignment/padding used by the content control. The scoped sentence is ten thousand characters in this pinned F2023 document, not the earlier 132-character limit.

accounting.rationale: PDF 71, printed 57, lines 12-13: account separately for placement freedom, the empty-line permission, and the numeric restriction. The actual heading is Free form line length.

Statements or their portions need not occupy fixed columns. Raw controls use column one and late starting positions, including a statement ending in column 10000. This permission does not waive the physical-line limit or canonical statement syntax.

Zero-character lines are permitted. Each line-limit asset contains one measured empty physical line as context. Its commentary/termination behavior belongs to 6.3.2.3, not an additional S requirement here.
The pinned text explicitly sets 10000, so both 10000/10001 boundaries are authored without silently applying a previous edition's limit.

review_rationale: Independent source-first review and recorded integration repairs: doc/source_audits/lexical_batch_004.json. Placement, empty-line permission and the whole-line 10000-character restriction are separated. Eight ASCII raw witnesses have measured boundaries, preserved trailing blanks and external expectations. Comments and blank equivalence do not erase characters from the physical-line limit.
